title: Run context v1
description: What one repo-run cell's agent CLI exposed about the run it made, written beside events.jsonl as run_context.json (docs/repo-evaluation-contract.md §4.9). Every field is taken from what the CLI printed (its start-up record, its closing record, its command line as dokimi started it) and is null when the CLI did not expose it, so a sparse trace gives nulls, not guesses. Config files are recorded as SHA-256 digests of their bytes, keyed by their name inside the per-run config directory or the workspace: no contents and no absolute paths. Names of plugins, skills, MCP servers and agents are the names the CLI printed.

run_id.description: The envelope: the id of the run that saved this file (dokimi.artifacts.run_id). Absent from files saved before the envelope.

dokimi_version.description: The envelope: the dokimi version that saved this file. Absent from files saved before the envelope.

harness.description: The harness profile's name (`claude-code`, `codex`, `copilot`), which dokimi started; the CLI does not print it.

harness_version.description: The CLI's own version: `claude_code_version` of the init record, else the version dokimi probed with the profile's `version_cmd` (`codex --version`).

model_requested.description: The model the evaluator asked for (`repo run --model`), whether or not the profile passes it to the CLI.

model_served.description: What answered. `init` is the model the init record (`system/init`) or the Copilot session start names; `usage` is the sorted keys of the closing record's `modelUsage`, which also lists helper models. Both null when the CLI printed neither.

effort.description: The effort the run ran at: the init record's `per_turn_effort_active` when printed, else the `--effort` flag, else Codex's `model_reasoning_effort` override (`-c`/`--config`) in the command line.

thinking.description: The value of a `--thinking` flag in the command line, else null.

credential_kind.description: The init record's `apiKeySource`, as the CLI names it (for example `none`, or the environment variable or login it read the key from). Null when the CLI prints none (Codex, Copilot).

permission_mode.description: How the run was allowed to act. Claude Code: `mode` is the init record's `permissionMode` (else the `--permission-mode` flag). Codex: `sandbox` is the `--sandbox` value, `approval` the `--ask-for-approval` value, and `mode` names `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` when that flag is given.

tools.description: Tool names. `allowed`: the init record's `tools` when printed, else the `--tools` flag's list (an empty list is no tool). `disallowed`: the `--disallowedTools` list. Null where the CLI has no such list (Codex runs under a sandbox instead).

extensions.description: What the init record listed, by name only: plugins, skills, MCP server names, agent names, and the output style. Each null when the init record does not list it.

outcome.description: How the run ended. `stop_reason` and `terminal_reason` are the closing record's own fields (Codex: `terminal_reason` is the closing record's type, `turn.completed` or `turn.failed`). `num_turns` is the CLI's count. `permission_denials` is the number of refused tool calls. `safety_stops` is the number of main-thread replies whose `stop_reason` was `refusal`.

config_sha256.description: SHA-256 of each config file dokimi wrote for the run (its per-run config directory) or the workspace file the profile's `args_if_present` named, taken before the agent started. Keys are file names, never paths: as the profile declares them (for example `settings.json`, `.mcp.json`), a nested workspace file by its base name, or by `workspace.` and its dotted path when that name is already a key; empty when there were none.
